test_cases.title: Idempotent activity ingest — happy path, intra-batch dedup, chunked upsert, program-scope rebuild only
test_cases.given: a valid bearer token scoped to program P1, an empty usage_events table, and a 5000-row activity batch whose last row duplicates the composite key (program_id, session_id, cmd_ts) of the first row
test_cases.when: the same payload is POSTed to /api/ingest/files twice in succession
test_cases.then: both requests return 200; first inserts 4999 unique rows and reports one intra_batch_duplicate reject; second reports 4999 updates and zero inserts; usage_events row count stays at 4999; program-scope rollup snapshots are byte-identical across the two runs; rebuild_org_rollups is never invoked in the request path; each request emits exactly one ingest_write_completed log with the allowlist fields only
test_cases.objective: Verify that a happy-path activity batch is validated, dedup'd, chunked-upserted, and program-rebuilt within the request path with correct counters + rollup summaries (AC-1), that re-POSTing the same payload produces no duplicate usage_events rows and identical rollups (AC-6), that org rebuild is scheduled out-of-band (FR-1 / C-9), that chunking respects the ≤2978 rows-per-INSERT ceiling (FR-2 / C-1), that intra-batch duplicates land in rejected[] with reason intra_batch_duplicate (FR-3 / C-2), and that the completion log obeys the PII allowlist (FR-8 / C-7).
preconditions: Fresh test database with usage_events table migrated (including additive source + copilot_credits columns from FR-4 migration)
One ingest_token row exists: token_hash=<HASH(TOKEN_P1)>, allowed_program_ids=["P1"], not revoked, not expired
No pre-existing usage_events rows for program_id="P1"
Test harness spies on app/services/rollup_rebuild.rebuild_org_rollups and structlog capture is enabled
Test harness can count SQL INSERT statements issued during the request (for chunk-count assertion)
steps: Build the 5000-row activity payload described in test_data (row[4999] duplicates row[0]'s composite key; all other rows have distinct session_id + cmd_ts)
POST /api/ingest/files with header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_P1> and JSON body {program_id: "P1", kind: "activity", rows: <5000-row array>}
Capture response A: HTTP status, JSON body, structlog records emitted during the request, and the count of INSERT statements executed against usage_events
Query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_events WHERE program_id = 'P1' → store as count_after_first
Snapshot the program_rollup rows for program_id = 'P1' → store as rollup_snapshot_A (ordered, canonicalised)
Assert rebuild_org_rollups spy was called zero times during request A
POST the identical payload a second time with the same Authorization header
Capture response B and the structlog records + INSERT count for request B
Query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_events WHERE program_id = 'P1' → store as count_after_second
Snapshot program_rollup rows for program_id = 'P1' → store as rollup_snapshot_B
Assert rebuild_org_rollups spy was called zero times during request B
expected_results: Response A: HTTP 200; body matches expected_first_response_counters exactly (received=5000, valid=4999, inserted=4999, updated=0, rejected=[{index:4999, reason:"intra_batch_duplicate"}])
Response A: body.rollup_summaries contains a program-scope entry keyed by program_id "P1" and NO org-scope entry (FR-1)
count_after_first == 4999 (dedup applied before upsert)
INSERT-statement count for request A ≤ ceil(4999 / 2978) = 2 (chunking honours _MAX_ROWS_PER_INSERT ≤ 2978)

Exactly one structlog record with event="ingest_write_completed" is emitted for request A; its key set equals expected_log_allowlist exactly (no user, command, feature, or row content); rows_rejected == 1
rebuild_org_rollups was not invoked during request A (C-9)
Response B: HTTP 200; body matches expected_second_response_counters exactly (received=5000, valid=4999, inserted=0, updated=4999)
count_after_second == 4999 (idempotence — no duplicate physical rows created by the second POST)
rollup_snapshot_B is byte-identical to rollup_snapshot_A (idempotent rollup — AC-6 / NFR-012)
Exactly one ingest_write_completed record for request B with rows_inserted=0, rows_updated=4999; keys still equal expected_log_allowlist exactly
rebuild_org_rollups was not invoked during request B

test_cases.title: Auth/authz denial + request-level validation abort + row-level rejection enumeration
test_cases.given: usage_events is empty; program P1 has a valid token T1 scoped to ["P1"]; a second program P2 has a valid token T2 scoped to ["OTHER"]; no program "UNKNOWN" exists; the endpoint's request-level validators are wired per FR-5 (mirroring manifest.py) and FR-7 (envelope kind)
test_cases.when: a sequence of denied and malformed requests is issued against /api/ingest/files, followed by one request whose envelope is valid but which contains a mix of malformed rows
test_cases.then: no-token → 401; wrong-scope token → 403; unknown program_id → 404; envelope kind != "activity" → 400; rows.length > 5000 → 413; all five reject-all responses write zero rows to usage_events; the mixed-row request returns 200 and enumerates one entry per bad row in rejected[] with reasons drawn from the FR-3 enum {malformed_iso_date, missing_required_field, intra_batch_duplicate}, while valid rows in the same batch commit; every rejection entry carries row index + reason only, never row content
test_cases.objective: Verify the auth/authz denial matrix routed through the mirrored get_ingest_token(...) wiring (AC-2 / AC-3 / FR-5), the request-level validation abort tier for envelope kind and row-cap (AC-4 / FR-7), the row-level rejection enumeration (AC-5 / FR-3), and the PII discipline of rejection response entries (C-7 / FR-8). Split into a hermetic auth-only module so token fixtures don't leak into the happy-path integration file.
preconditions: Fresh test database with usage_events table migrated
ingest_token row 1: token_hash=<HASH(TOKEN_P1)>, allowed_program_ids=["P1"], not revoked, not expired
ingest_token row 2: token_hash=<HASH(TOKEN_P2)>, allowed_program_ids=["OTHER"], not revoked, not expired
ingest_token row 3: token_hash=<HASH(TOKEN_REVOKED)>, allowed_program_ids=["P1"], revoked_at=<past timestamp>
Program rows exist for program_id in {"P1", "OTHER"}; no row exists for program_id="UNKNOWN"
usage_events is empty at test start; harness re-checks emptiness after each reject-all sub-step

mixed_row_batch.defect: duplicates row at pos 3 on (program_id, session_id, cmd_ts)
none — valid row B (unknown top-level field "vendor_tag" present, must be dropped silently per FR-4)

steps: POST /api/ingest/files with body {program_id: "P1", kind: "activity", rows: [<valid_row_template>]} and NO Authorization header
Assert HTTP 401; assert SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_events == 0
POST the same body with header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_REVOKED>
Assert HTTP 401; assert usage_events still empty
POST the same body with header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_P2> (allowed_program_ids=["OTHER"], targeting program_id="P1")
Assert HTTP 403; assert usage_events still empty
POST body {program_id: "UNKNOWN", kind: "activity", rows: [<valid_row_template with program_id patched>]} with header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_P1>
Assert HTTP 404; assert usage_events still empty
POST body {program_id: "P1", kind: "artifacts", rows: [<valid_row_template>]} with header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_P1>
Assert HTTP 400; assert usage_events still empty (envelope kind rejected at request tier per FR-7)
POST body {program_id: "P1", kind: "activity", rows: <5001 valid rows>} with header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_P1>
Assert HTTP 413; assert usage_events still empty (row-cap abort per AC-4)
POST body {program_id: "P1", kind: "activity", rows: <mixed_row_batch materialised>} with header Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_P1>
Capture response body and structlog records
Query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_events WHERE program_id = 'P1' → store as count_after_mixed
Scan every rejection entry in the mixed-request response body for any key in forbidden_pii_keys_in_response
expected_results: No-token POST returns HTTP 401; usage_events remains empty (AC-2)
Revoked-token POST returns HTTP 401; usage_events remains empty (AC-2)
Wrong-scope-token POST returns HTTP 403; usage_events remains empty (AC-3)
Unknown-program POST returns HTTP 404 (via get_ingest_token program lookup per FR-5); usage_events remains empty
Envelope kind="artifacts" returns HTTP 400; zero writes (FR-7 shared envelope-kind vocabulary)
5001-row POST returns HTTP 413 before any row is processed; zero writes (AC-4)
Mixed-row POST returns HTTP 200; response counters equal expected_mixed_batch_counters exactly (received=5, valid=2, inserted=2, updated=0, rejected list matches by index + reason)
count_after_mixed == 2 (valid rows at positions 3 and 4 committed; unknown field "vendor_tag" on the pos-4 row was dropped silently per FR-4 without causing rejection)
No rejection entry in the mixed-request response contains any key from forbidden_pii_keys_in_response — only {index, reason} are present (C-7 / FR-8)
Rejection reason enum used by the response is a subset of {malformed_iso_date, missing_required_field, intra_batch_duplicate} (FR-3 / AC-5 reworded)

operator_directive.rationale: Operator directive in PRD § Test strategy caps AC-mapped test cases at 2. Consolidation strategy: TC-01 collapses AC-1 + AC-6 + C-1/C-2/C-9 into one end-to-end idempotence run; TC-02 collapses AC-2 + AC-3 + AC-4 + AC-5 + FR-5/FR-7 into one auth/validation denial run. Residual coverage rides as targeted unit tests scheduled in /arh-plan-implementation (see uncovered_disposition).

uncovered_disposition.ING-02-FR-4: Wire-shape field aliasing + additive migration verified by a targeted unit test on the API-alias mapper (unit test scheduled in /arh-plan-implementation, not an AC-mapped TC).
uncovered_disposition.ING-02-FR-6: Housekeeping (stub deletion + orphan removal + SKILL.md citation update). Not a runtime behaviour — verified by plan-validation cross-section check and by the app-boot smoke that /ingest/events now returns 404.
uncovered_disposition.ING-02-NFR-performance: p95 ≤ 3s @ 5000 rows against seeded 160k-row table — covered by tests/perf/test_ingest_files_perf.py (C-10) scheduled in /arh-plan-implementation as a type: performance test, not enumerated here per operator directive.
